item.text: I’m reconstructing the repeated, shuffled instructions and tracking whole-box swaps separately from individual-object moves.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from collections import Counter
import re
s=open('/tmp/shuffled.txt').read()
toks=re.findall(r\"COLOR|[A-Za-z]+|\\d+|[=;:,.]\",s)
c=Counter(toks)
for k,v in sorted(c.items(), key=lambda kv:(-kv[1],kv[0])):
 print(f'{k:12} {v:3} /3={v/3:g}')
print('total',len(toks), 'orig',len(toks)/3)
PY"
